scenarios.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thank you for taking the time to talk with me at the SEO Career Summit in New York. I enjoyed hearing more about Morrow & Pike.

My name is Maya Okafor, and I'm a sophomore at Duke University, graduating in May 2029, writing to a fellow Duke alum now recruiting for the firm.

I've been drawn to consumer and retail M&A, an interest that grew out of covering the consumer sector for Duke Investment Club and building a dividend stock screening model during my internship at Pinecrest Wealth Partners.

I had two questions, if you have a moment. First, when does the sophomore program at Morrow & Pike typically open for applications? Second, does that program feed directly into the summer analyst class, or is the summer process separate?

My resume is attached. Thank you again for your time!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
maya.okafor@duke.edu
(919) 555-0142

scenarios.body:
Hi Rachel,

It was great meeting you at the SEO Career Summit in New York! We spent a good chunk of our conversation on the grocery chain turnaround you worked on, and what has stuck with me since is your point that consumer deals really come down to whether customers keep coming back.

As a quick reminder, I'm a sophomore at Duke studying economics. This past summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for dividend stocks, and I'm a consumer sector analyst with the Duke Investment Club. Consumer and retail M&A is the part of finance I keep coming back to, and our talk only sharpened that.

I was glad to learn afterward that you're a fellow Duke alum, and it turns out we're both from Atlanta too.

Would you have 10-15 minutes for a call sometime? I'd love to hear how you moved from Duke into consumer coverage. Whatever time works on your end works for me, and I attached my resume for reference.

Thank you again for the conversation in New York!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
